album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 1

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C5 and dwells most on C in Sayakhi. The line peaks at Ds5 (613.6 Hz) at 0:24.0. It closes on D5, not the tonic (G4 → Ak4 → Bb4 → C5 → D5 → D5).

theory_fit.name: Farhat interval classes
